title: End-to-end stdio test self-skips if bss-mcp-server binary is absent
evidence: tests_main.m:559-562 — testEndToEnd prints 'SKIP: bss-mcp-server binary not found' and returns when the binary is not co-located. In the final archived run the binary was present and the test ran ('server exits cleanly on EOF' precedes the final '100 passed, 0 failed').
suggestion: Fail rather than skip when the binary is missing, or build it as a test prerequisite, so the e2e path can never silently vanish.
